caption_en: On 9 November 1880 an earthquake struck Zagreb. Its epicentre was on Medvednica, the mountain north of the city.
caption_sv: Dana 9. studenoga 1880. Zagreb je pogodio potres. Epicentar mu je bio na Medvednici, planini sjeverno od grada.

caption_en: Many buildings were damaged. In the cathedral the quake brought down the vaults and damaged the bell tower.
caption_sv: Mnoge su zgrade oštećene. U katedrali je potres srušio svodove i oštetio zvonik.
photo_caption_en: Inside the cathedral after the earthquake, 1880 (photo Ivan Standl)
photo_caption_sv: Unutrašnjost katedrale nakon potresa, 1880. (snimio Ivan Standl)

caption_en: St Mark's Church was being renovated when the quake hit. The work ended in 1882, in neo-Gothic style, to designs by Friedrich von Schmidt and Hermann Bollé.
caption_sv: Crkva sv. Marka bila je u obnovi kad je udario potres. Radovi su završeni 1882. u neogotičkom stilu, prema nacrtima Friedricha von Schmidta i Hermanna Bolléa.
photo_file: Roof of St, Mark's Church, Zagreb.jpg
photo_caption_en: The tiled roof of St Mark's

caption_en: Bollé also built the Greek Catholic church of Saints Cyril and Methodius, on the site of a chapel the quake had damaged.
caption_sv: Bollé je projektirao i grkokatoličku crkvu sv. Ćirila i Metoda, na mjestu kapele oštećene u potresu.

caption_en: The cathedral was rebuilt in neo-Gothic style, led by Hermann Bollé to plans by Friedrich von Schmidt. Its spires rise about 108 metres.
caption_sv: Katedrala je obnovljena u neogotičkom stilu. Radove je vodio Hermann Bollé prema nacrtima Friedricha von Schmidta. Tornjevi su visoki oko 108 metara.
sources: Zagreb Cathedral; Zagrebačka katedrala (hr); landmark card
photo_caption_en: The old cathedral after the earthquake, 1880 (photo Hinko Krapek)
photo_caption_sv: Stara katedrala nakon potresa, 1880. (snimio Hinko Krapek)

caption_en: Between 1880 and 1914 the city grew fast and took its present layout. Many of the dated Lower Town buildings on this map come from these years.
caption_sv: Između 1880. i 1914. grad je brzo rastao i dobio današnji raspored. Mnoge datirane zgrade Donjeg grada na ovoj karti potječu iz tih godina.
sources: History of Zagreb; this map's data

caption_en: On 22 March 2020 the strongest earthquake since 1880 hit Zagreb. It damaged one of the cathedral's spires, and the restoration is still going on.
caption_sv: Dana 22. ožujka 2020. Zagreb je pogodio najjači potres nakon 1880. Oštetio je jedan od tornjeva katedrale, a obnova još traje.
